crossRefs.note: The children of Bani, six hundred forty-two.
The children of Binnui: six hundred forty-eight.

people.name: Adaiah
people.line: A leader who married a foreign wife

people.name: Bani
people.line: Ancestor of a family who returned from Babylonian exile.

people.name: Jashub
people.line: Israelite who married a foreign woman during Ezra's time

people.name: Jeremoth
people.line: A descendant of Bani who married a foreign wife.

people.name: Malluch
people.line: Descendant of Bani, who divorced his foreign wife.

people.name: Meshullam
people.line: An Israelite who had married a foreign woman.

people.name: Sheal
people.line: Israelite who divorced his foreign wife

translations.web: Of the sons of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, and Adaiah, Jashub, and Sheal, Jeremoth.
translations.bsb: From the descendants of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth.
translations.kjv: And of the sons of Bani; Meshullam, Malluch, and Adaiah, Jashub, and Sheal, and Ramoth.
translations.asv: And of the sons of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, and Adaiah, Jashub, and Sheal, Jeremoth.
